card.name: Verb slot before contact or interaction words
card.fires_on: The word right after a drug or product name, usually a verb like may, be, comes, or the noun tablets, where the next words are likely to be about contact (with lenses, fabric) or interactions with other drugs.

modes.label: Contact lens warnings
modes.description: Helper verb such as be or may in a contact lens wear section.
modes.example: 5.4 Contact Lens Wear ILEVRO ® 0.3% should not<< be>> administered while using contact lenses.

modes.label: Drug interaction statements
modes.description: The word tablets or may right after a drug name in a drug interaction passage.
modes.example: 7.2 Effect of Capecitabine Tablets on Other Drugs CYP2C9 Substrates Capecitabine<< tablets>> increased exposure of CYP2C9

modes.label: Product touching surfaces
modes.description: Verb about the product coming into contact with fabric or skin.
modes.example: excessive amount of the product is used and<< comes>> in contact with white fabrics.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like contacting, interacting and interaction, plus their Chinese equivalents, as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the spot after a drug name where the text is about to talk about contact or interactions.
